text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан finishes first at the Arima
Kinen.
However, she and Бива Хаяхидэ
are both aiming
to achieve even greater
goals.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
From the stands, Симболи Рудольф's heart
leaps
with quiet excitement. She too
wants to face
Нарита Брайан someday...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Those who have been defeated are
aiming for the
top, just the same as
Нарита Брайан. They will
always continue
to be her competitors.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And so, the curtain falls on the Arima
Kinen.
Нарита Брайан will continue to run
from here on out
in her never-ending
search for stronger
opponents.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
